Container.Name: Reprise
Container.Overview: Self-hosted media analysis and review. In development: review results and keep production publishing disabled during evaluation. The pinned image is a specific published build; select a newer published immutable image to update. Media is read-only; Plex database access is not mounted by default.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU UUID (optional)
Config.Description: Optional NVIDIA GPU for analysis video decoding (NVDEC). Leave void for none. To use one, set its UUID (nvidia-smi -L on the host) and add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters; Reprise falls back to the CPU on any GPU problem.

Config.Name: NVIDIA driver capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA runtime capabilities; video supplies the NVDEC library. Keep this in the variable field, not as a bare Extra Parameters assignment. No effect while the GPU UUID is void.

Config.Name: Plex config folder (optional)
Config.Description: Container path containing Plex Media/localhost, matching the Plex server output folder. Case-sensitive; mount only the needed subtree read-only for review-only use. A mount alone does not set this variable.

Config.Name: Working folder
Config.Description: Writable storage-backed scratch folder with at least 1 GiB free. Configuration validation creates it if needed; avoid the small /tmp tmpfs for processing scratch.
